succinit Costerus. {1}Reddet unicuique secundum opera.] Observandum est, Scripturam, quando de Retributione loquitur, eadem verborum formula uti; cum agit de

liter se habent: sin spectemus modum vel

dendam non opus est aliquâ nostrâ confuta-

tia (quâ nihil potest esse homini magis ad-

in eodem Tractatu de Meritis veritas ipsa hanc

page.notes: Running head taken as "Sect. 5. CONTRA MERITA, &c." with the page number 19 at the top right. Doubtful readings: "mortem" in the first line is hard to read and marked [?]. "supplicìis" and "Supplicììsque" are uncertain in the print and copied as seen. The catchword "mio;" is the start of the next page, and the paragraph ends on the hyphenated word "prae-". Note marks "1" and "k" are set in the text as printed. The note "Idem ibid. Sol. ad Ob. 4." is printed with a bullet before the 4.
